To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a new method to measure quadratures of matter waves.
We demonstrate the direct detection of quadratures of massive particles, and use it to detect entanglement and twin-atom character.
we have realized an atomic homodyne detector, and used it to measure continuous-variable entangled states.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of new techniques to study the properties of quantum states.
the generation and detection of quantum entanglement of continuous variables in massive particles.
the development and application of new methods for the manipulation and measurement of quantum fields.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the experimental realization of a continuous variable homodyne detector for matter waves has been achieved.
the experimental results of the present paper demonstrate the possibility of detecting entangled continuous-variable states of massive particles.
we have demonstrated the first direct homodyne detection scheme for matter-waves.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated an analogue of homodyne measurement of quadratures of quantum fields for massive particles.
we have demonstrated an atomic analogue to optical homodyne detection, and applied this technique to the measurement of continuous-variable entanglment of massive particles.
we have demonstrated a new technique to detect and manipulate the quadratures of massive quantum particles.
The main takeaway from our work is that

it provides a direct measurement technique for the quadratures of atomic fields, which is a key resource for the realization of quantum-enhanced measurements, the demonstration of the EPR paradox, and the implementation of quantum memories.
we have developed a new tool for quantum metrology, quantum state engineering and the study of many-body quantum systems.
we can now measure matter wave quadratures.
